ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company, Greenridge Exploration Inc., is listed at the end of the article: "Russell Starr Chief Executive Officer, Director".

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for a complete interest in the projects: "...to acquire a 100% interest in the Snook Lake and Ranger Lake Uranium Projects..."

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a press release about the Ranger Lake project acquisition, but no URL for the article was included in the source text.
